steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Command words tell you exactly what the examiner wants — misreading them loses marks | Key Fact: Describe means give a factual account of what you see, hear or know about the dance | Key Fact: Explain means give reasons — why something happens or why a choreographer made a choice | Key Fact: Analyse means break down and examine in detail, showing how parts create meaning or effect

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from command words &amp; question types, and one past-paper question.
